        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def f(g):
    from collections import Counter
    flat=[x for r in g for x in r]
    bg=Counter(flat).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bars=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(g):
        c=0
        while c<len(row):
            if row[c]!=bg:
                v=row[c]; s=c
                while c<len(row) and row[c]==v: c+=1
                bars.append((v,r,s))
            else: c+=1
    bars.sort(key=lambda b:-b[0])
    cells=[b[0] for b in bars]
    while len(cells)<6: cells.append(0)
    return [cells[:3],cells[3:]]
